_instructions: Fill in the dates you mowed each property, then tap Import in the app. Use YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2026-08-15). You can list up to 3 dates as an array, most recent first, e.g. ["2026-08-15", "2026-08-01", "2026-07-18"]. A single date string also works. Leave a value blank ("") to skip that property. The _instructions line is ignored by the app.
